title: Fix crash in Client.fetch with trailing whitespace
body:
## What this PR does
Fixes a crash in `Client.fetch` when the URL has trailing whitespace, by normalising the host in `src/widget/net.py`.

- Adds unit tests for the new behaviour
- Updates the documentation
- No breaking changes: the public API is unchanged
author: contributor

@@ -14,5 +14,2 @@ def parse_url(url: str) -> dict:
     return {"scheme": parts.scheme, "host": parts.hostname, "path": parts.path}
